items.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: And that’s how I met Basie.

ctx.x: Were you and Count Basie in Kansas City about the same time?
Yes. Well I came in right after Basie left and went east.
You and the count were kind of compatriots in the same kind of music.

items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I never heard Basie until after he came back from East. I never heard Basie's band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Bill went to the West Coast.
Yes, yes. And he was playing bass with Bus Moten Band. See, Basie's gone East already, see?
